data.title: Could Bitcoin Reach Brian Armstrong’s $400,000 Target by 2030?
data.description: Coinbase's CEO has already slashed his Bitcoin forecast once, and the coin now sits more than half below its peak. What would it take for his revised 2030 target to survive, and why is his own company's stock sinking even faster?
